# @moku-labs/native

> Node-only native packager framework for Moku, built on @moku-labs/core: it generates a gitignored Tauri 2 project, codegens the permission surface (capabilities JSON, Info.ios.plist sidecar, AndroidManifest needs) from whichever system plugins the app composed, and runs `tauri build` for five targets (macos, windows, linux, ios, android).

## Core Concepts

### Three-layer Moku model
- Layer 1 (`src/config.ts`): `createCoreConfig<Config, Events, [logPlugin, envPlugin]>("native", ...)` — global Config + Events types, shared constants (`TARGETS`, `PHASE_ORDER`), registers the `@moku-labs/common` core plugins so every plugin ctx carries `ctx.log` and `ctx.env`.
- Layer 2 (`src/index.ts`): `createCore(coreConfig, { plugins: [projectPlugin, tauriPlugin, buildPlugin, doctorPlugin, cliPlugin], pluginConfigs: {...} })` — the framework.
- Layer 3 (consumer): `createApp({ config, plugins?, pluginConfigs? })` — a consumer app instance with `native.project/.tauri/.build/.doctor/.cli` APIs plus `native.start()`/`native.stop()`.

### The composition is the permission surface
`config.system` is a name-only array (`ReadonlyArray<{ name: string }>`). The project plugin resolves each name against a 5-row capability registry (store, notification, clipboard-manager, tray, deep-link) into npm/crate dependency ranges, Rust plugin-init lines, capability permission JSON, tauri.conf fragments, and per-platform applicability. Unknown names throw at composition time (project.onInit). v1 mobile permission codegen is conf-only (D-012): zero XML patching ships; official Tauri plugins self-merge their own AndroidManifest needs; deep-link is custom-scheme-only (D-011: `{ mode: "scheme", scheme }` — the `mode` discriminant keeps `"universal"` additive later).

### The two-createApp consumer shape (D-009)
A native app is a SEPARATE `createApp` (e.g. `src/native.ts`) composed BESIDE the consumer's web/node app — plugins are bound to their own framework's factory chain, so native plugins can never join the web app's plugin array. Integration happens at the edges:
- `src/system.ts` — the shared array of `{ name }` system-plugin declarations; both apps import it; it is the cross-team contract.
- package.json wires thin per-verb consumer scripts (`native:build`, `native:dev`, `native:doctor`, `native:clean`), each a small file that does `await native.start(); await native.cli.<verb>(...); await native.stop();` — there is no argv CLI.
- Directory roles: `projectDir` (default `.moku/tauri/`) = the generated, GITIGNORED, fully regenerable Tauri project (contains `src-tauri/`); `outDir` (default `dist-native/`) = final packaged installers per target (`dist-native/<target>/`).

### Pipeline and events
`build.run({ target })` walks `PHASE_ORDER` = scaffold → codegen → icons → compile → bundle → collect, sequentially, stopping at the first failing phase. It emits the GLOBAL framework events `native:phase` (start/progress/done/error per phase) and `native:complete` (on success) — declared in `src/config.ts` (D-003), emitted by build, hooked by cli for live rendering, hookable by any plugin without a depends edge. `doctor:check` stays a per-plugin event (declared by doctor; hooking it needs a `depends: [doctorPlugin]` edge). The icons phase is a permanent v1 no-op (D-015): no icon-source config field exists, so it always reports done with detail "skipped". compile+bundle share ONE `tauri build` subprocess; a failure is always attributed to compile and bundle is never emitted.

### Seams and conventions
- `tauri` is the ONLY plugin that spawns processes (invocation: explicit PATH-walked `node` + `require.resolve("@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js")` — never `bunx tauri`, never `process.execPath` which is bun; D-013).
- Every subprocess output line is scrubbed (known secret env-var names + Shannon-entropy gating) before reaching any log, callback, or error.
- Signing config carries env-var REFERENCES only; doctor checks presence (`ctx.env.has`), never values.
- All CLI output flows through the branded kit `@moku-labs/common/cli` (MC1); logging via `ctx.log` (MC2); env via `ctx.env` (MC3).
- Dev teardown is owned by the tauri dev seam's own control flow (process-group spawn, SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers, `DevHandle.stop()`) — there is no `onStop` (D-002); cli awaits the handle but never holds or stops it.
- `project` owns `clean` (D-006); `cli.clean` is a thin delegate, confirm-gated when wiping the whole projectDir.

## Quick Reference

```ts
import {
  createApp, createPlugin,            // framework API (Layer 3 factory + consumer plugin factory)
  projectPlugin, tauriPlugin, buildPlugin, doctorPlugin, cliPlugin,
  TARGETS, PHASE_ORDER,               // constants
  type Config, type Events, type Target, type NativePhase,
  type NativePhaseEvent, type NativeCompleteEvent,
  type CapabilityConfigMap, type SigningConfig,
  Project, Tauri, Build, Doctor, Cli  // per-plugin type namespaces (e.g. Tauri.DevHandle, Tauri.TauriError)
} from "@moku-labs/native";

// Layer 3
const native = createApp({
  config: { app, web, system, capabilities, targets, projectDir, outDir, signing },
  plugins: [],        // optional consumer-authored plugins
  pluginConfigs: { tauri: {...}, doctor: {...}, cli: {...} }
});
await native.start();

// cli verbs (typed methods, no argv parsing)
native.cli.build(opts?: { target?: Target; all?: boolean }): Promise<void>;
native.cli.dev(opts?: { target?: Target }): Promise<void>;      // resolves on clean/signal exit
native.cli.doctor(opts?: { target?: Target }): Promise<boolean>; // caller sets process.exitCode
native.cli.clean(opts?: { target?: Target }): Promise<void>;    // no target => confirm-gated full wipe

// build pipeline
native.build.run(opts: { target: Target }): Promise<Build.BuildResult>;
native.build.runAll(opts?: { targets?: readonly Target[] }): Promise<readonly Build.BuildResult[]>; // sequential, never Promise.all

// project (files only, never spawns)
native.project.generate(opts: { target: Target }): Promise<{ written: string[]; unchanged: string[]; skipped: string[] }>;
native.project.completeness(opts: { target: Target }): Project.CompletenessResult; // "not-applicable" | "not-initialized" | "incomplete" | "complete"
native.project.patchMobile(opts: { target: "ios" | "android" }): Promise<{ patched: string[]; unchanged: string[] }>;
native.project.clean(opts?: { target?: Target }): Promise<{ removed: readonly string[] }>;
native.project.resolve<K extends keyof CapabilityConfigMap>(name: K, config?: CapabilityConfigMap[K]): Project.ResolvedCapability;
native.project.isKnownCapability(name: string): name is keyof CapabilityConfigMap;
native.project.registryRows(): ReadonlyArray<Project.RegistryRow>;
native.project.requiredFiles(platform: "ios" | "android"): readonly string[];

// tauri (the only subprocess seam; one-shot verbs throw Tauri.TauriError on non-zero exit)
native.tauri.icon(opts: { source: string }): Promise<Tauri.RunResult>;
native.tauri.build(opts: { target: Target; onTick?: (t: Tauri.CompileTick) => void; onOutput?: (line: string) => void }): Promise<Tauri.RunResult>;
native.tauri.mobileInit(opts: { platform: "ios" | "android" }): Promise<Tauri.RunResult>; // NOT idempotent — gate on completeness() first
native.tauri.dev(opts: { target?: Target; onOutput?: (line: string) => void }): Promise<Tauri.DevHandle>;
native.tauri.version(): Promise<{ cliVersion: string } | null>;  // null = CLI not invokable (never throws)

// doctor (never throws on check failures; rejected checks become internal-error "fail" rows)
native.doctor.run(opts?: { target?: Target }): Promise<Doctor.DoctorReport>; // { ok, checks } — warn never flips ok

await native.stop();
```

Key types:

```ts
type Target = "macos" | "windows" | "linux" | "ios" | "android";
type NativePhase = "scaffold" | "codegen" | "icons" | "compile" | "bundle" | "collect";

type Config = {
  app: { name: string; identifier: string; version?: string };
  web: { build: string; dev: { command: string; url: string }; dist: string; cwd?: string };
  system: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string }>;
  capabilities: Partial<CapabilityConfigMap>;
  targets: readonly Target[];
  projectDir: string;   // default ".moku/tauri"
  outDir: string;       // default "dist-native"
  signing: SigningConfig;
};

type CapabilityConfigMap = {
  store: Record<string, never>;
  notification: Record<string, never>;
  "clipboard-manager": Record<string, never>;
  tray: Record<string, never>;
  "deep-link": { mode: "scheme"; scheme: string };
};

type SigningConfig = {
  android?: { keystorePath?: string; keystorePasswordEnv?: string; keyAlias?: string };
  windows?: { certificateThumbprint?: string };
};

type Events = {
  "native:phase": { target: Target; phase: NativePhase; status: "start" | "progress" | "done" | "error"; durationMs?: number; detail?: string };
  "native:complete": { target: Target; outPath: string; artifacts: readonly string[]; durationMs: number };
};

// per-plugin (doctor)
type CheckResult = { id: string; target: Target | "host"; status: "pass" | "warn" | "fail"; message: string; fixIt?: string };

type DevHandle = { url: string; ready: Promise<void>; exited: Promise<{ code: number | null; signal: string | null }>; stop(): Promise<void> };

class TauriError extends Error {
  kind: "toolchain-missing" | "config-invalid" | "compile-failed" | "signing-failed" | "device-unavailable" | "cancelled" | "unknown";
  exitCode: number | null;
  stderrTail: string; // already scrubbed — safe to log
}

type BuildResult = { target: Target; outPath: string; artifacts: readonly string[]; durationMs: number; phases: ReadonlyArray<{ phase: NativePhase; durationMs: number }> };
```

Config defaults (framework `defaultConfig`): `app: { name: "", identifier: "" }` (must be set; validated), `web: { build: "bun run build", dev: { command: "bun run dev", url: "http://localhost:5173" }, dist: "dist" }`, `system: []`, `capabilities: {}`, `targets: TARGETS` (all five), `projectDir: ".moku/tauri"`, `outDir: "dist-native"`, `signing: {}`.

Per-plugin configs (via `createApp({ pluginConfigs })`):
- `tauri: { spawnImpl?: SpawnFn; nodePath?: string; readiness: { intervalMs: number; timeoutMs: number } }` — defaults: undefined / undefined / `{ intervalMs: 250, timeoutMs: 60_000 }`.
- `doctor: { probeImpl?: ProbeFn }` — default undefined (real which/--version subprocess probes).
- `cli: { renderImpl?: (line: string) => void; confirmImpl?: (question: string) => Promise<boolean> }` — defaults undefined (branded console + styled confirm from `@moku-labs/common/cli`).

## File Structure

```
src/
  config.ts               # Layer 1: Config/Events types, TARGETS, PHASE_ORDER, CapabilityConfigMap,
                          #   SigningConfig, createCoreConfig("native"), createPlugin/createCore exports
  index.ts                # Layer 2: createCore(...5 plugins), framework pluginConfigs defaults,
                          #   public exports: createApp, createPlugin, constants, types, plugin barrel
  plugins/
    index.ts              # barrel: plugin instances + type namespaces (Project, Tauri, Build, Doctor, Cli)
    project/              # Complex tier
      index.ts types.ts api.ts registry.ts writer.ts completeness.ts patch.ts clean.ts
      generators/         # tauri-conf.ts cargo.ts rust.ts capabilities.ts sidecar.ts types.ts
    tauri/                # Standard tier
      index.ts types.ts api.ts argv.ts resolve.ts spawn.ts dev.ts stream.ts errors.ts scrub.ts state.ts
    build/                # Standard tier
      index.ts types.ts api.ts pipeline.ts collect.ts
    doctor/               # Complex tier
      index.ts types.ts api.ts report.ts
      checks/             # index.ts types.ts rustup.ts node.ts xcode.ts android.ts signing.ts
                          #   completeness.ts versions.ts web-script.ts tauri-cli.ts cross-repo.ts
    cli/                  # Standard tier
      index.ts types.ts api.ts handlers.ts render.ts state.ts
tests/                    # framework-level integration only; plugin tests are colocated in
                          #   src/plugins/<name>/__tests__/{unit,integration}/
```

## Plugins

- **project** — Capability registry + `.moku/tauri` generators (tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml, main.rs/lib.rs, capability JSON, Info.ios.plist sidecar) + write-if-changed writer + mobile completeness gate + Android-signing patch + clean; never spawns | tier: Complex | API: generate, completeness, patchMobile, clean, resolve, isKnownCapability, registryRows, requiredFiles | events: none (onInit validates global config).
- **tauri** — The only `@tauri-apps/cli` subprocess seam: argv builders, injectable spawn, process-group dev lifecycle with devUrl readiness poll, compile-tick stream parsing, TauriError taxonomy, entropy-gated secret scrubbing; NO onStop by design (D-002) | tier: Standard | API: icon, build, mobileInit, dev, version | events: none.
- **build** — Sequential per-target pipeline (scaffold→codegen→icons→compile→bundle→collect); depends [project, tauri]; owns collect (BUNDLE_LOCATIONS glob table → outDir/<target>/, zero matches is an error); runAll is sequential (shared Cargo target/ lock) | tier: Standard | API: run, runAll | events: emits global native:phase + native:complete.
- **doctor** — Parallel diagnosis via checks/ registry (rustup, node, xcode, android, signing presence, mobile completeness, npm-vs-crate version skew, web-script existence, tauri-cli, cross-repo warns); Promise.allSettled — rejected checks become internal-error fails; warns never flip `ok` | tier: Complex | API: run | events: declares + emits doctor:check per completed check.
- **cli** — Typed verb surface (build/dev/doctor/clean), NO argv parsing; branded rendering via @moku-labs/common/cli (MC1); live progress via hooks on native:phase/native:complete/doctor:check; depends on all four other plugins | tier: Standard | API: build, dev, doctor, clean | events: none declared — hooks only.

Dependency graph (D-007): project and tauri are dependency-free (Wave 1); build → [project, tauri] and doctor → [project, tauri] (Wave 2); cli → [project, tauri, build, doctor] (Wave 3). Initialization order follows the plugin array: project, tauri, build, doctor, cli.

## Minimal consumer example

```ts
// src/system.ts (shared with the web app)
export const systemPlugins = [{ name: "store" }, { name: "deep-link" }];

// src/native.ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/native";
import { systemPlugins } from "./system";

export const native = createApp({
  config: {
    app: { name: "MyApp", identifier: "com.example.myapp" },
    web: { build: "bun run build", dev: { command: "bun run dev", url: "http://localhost:5173" }, dist: "dist" },
    system: systemPlugins,
    capabilities: { "deep-link": { mode: "scheme", scheme: "myapp" } }
  }
});

// scripts/native-build.ts
import { native } from "../src/native";
await native.start();
await native.cli.build({ target: "macos" }); // installers land in dist-native/macos/
await native.stop();
```

Add `.moku/` and `dist-native/` to the consumer `.gitignore`. A real `node` binary on PATH is a hard prerequisite (`@tauri-apps/cli` cannot run under bun; `native doctor` checks it). Package manager: bun exclusively.

## Error handling

- Every framework error message is `[native]`-prefixed with an actionable second line (fix-it style).
- `tauri` one-shot verbs throw classified `TauriError` (kind + exitCode + scrubbed stderrTail).
- `build` emits `native:phase` status "error" for the failing phase, then rethrows; later phases never start; `runAll` stops at the first failing target.
- `doctor.run` never throws on check failures — a rejected check becomes a `"fail"` CheckResult with an internal-error message.
- `cli.dev` resolves cleanly on signal-terminated exits (code null, e.g. Ctrl-C) and throws only on a numeric non-zero exit code.
- `cli.clean()` without a target gates the full projectDir wipe behind a styled confirm; declining resolves without deleting.
- Config validation (project.onInit, composition time): empty app.name, non-reverse-DNS app.identifier, missing web.build/web.dev.command/web.dev.url/web.dist, unknown config.system names, deep-link composed without a scheme.

See llms-full.txt for verbatim type definitions, the full config/event catalog, per-check details, and extension patterns. Per-plugin READMEs: src/plugins/{project,tauri,build,doctor,cli}/README.md.
